problems.reason: The page lists several studies assigning Unquillosaurus to different clades (Carnosauria, Maniraptora, Dromaeosauridae, Carcharodontosauridae, Unenlagiinae) without reconciling them, creating conflicting taxonomic claims.
Both sentences state that Unquillosaurus is part of Carcharodontosauridae, repeating the same classification.
Both sentences mention placement in Carnosauria, repeating the same taxonomic assignment.

notes: - contradiction: "Powell originally assigned Unquillosaurus to the Carnosauria in 1979, a group of large carnivorous dinosaurs." / "However, in 2004, Novas and Agnolin concluded that the animal belonged to Maniraptora or at least Maniraptoriformes based on its opisthopubic pelvic anatomy." / "Later, Martínez and Novas suggested in 2006 that Unquillosaurus likely belonged to the maniraptoran clade Dromaeosauridae." / "In 2012, Carrano and colleagues classified it as a member of Carcharodontosauridae due to similarities with Giganotosaurus." / "By 2024, researchers considering the taxonomy of Diuqin suggested Unquillosaurus might be a member of the Unenlagiinae." / "Currently, the Paleobiology Database lists the parent group of Unquillosaurus as Carcharodontosauridae." / "Initially, Unquillosaurus was thought to belong to a giant theropod 11 meters long, but in 2012, Carrano et al. reclassified the animal into Carnosauria, specifically Carcharodontosauria, suggesting the original interpretation was likely correct.": The page lists several studies assigning Unquillosaurus to different clades (Carnosauria, Maniraptora, Dromaeosauridae, Carcharodontosauridae, Unenlagiinae) without reconciling them, creating conflicting taxonomic claims.
